title: On the Origin of Species by Means of Natural Selection
author: Charles Darwin
body:
This audio reading of On the Origin of Species by Means of Natural
Selection is read by

Annie Coleman,
Kara Shallenberg,
Hugh McGuire,
David Barnes,
Rainer,
Guntar,
Chip,
Gesine,
Kurt Wong,
Anita Roy Dobbs,
Julian Jamison,
Denny Sayers,
Peter Yearsley,
Nikolle Doolin,
Betsie Bush

Read by: Annie Coleman

# 01B: Variation Under Domestication - Part 2 - 00:57:46
Read by: Annie Coleman

Read by: Kara Shallenberg

Read by: David Barnes

Read by: David Barnes

Read by: Rainer

Read by: Guntar

Read by: Guntar

Read by: Chip

Read by: Chip

# 08A: Instinct - Part 1 - 00:40:06

Read by: Kurt Wong

# 08C: Instinct - Part 3 - 00:20:34
Read by: Anita Roy Dobbs

# 09A: Hybridism - Part 1 - 00:42:44
Read by: David Barnes

# 09B: Hybridism - Part 2 - 00:57:10
Read by: David Barnes

# 10A: On the Imperfection of the Geological Record - Part 1 - 00:31:48
Read by: Julian Jamison

# 10B: On the Imperfection of the Geological Record - Part 2 - 00:41:32
Read by: Julian Jamison

# 11A: On the Geological Succession of Organic Beings - Part 1 - 00:43:58
Read by: Denny Sayers

# 11B: On the Geological Succession of Organic Beings - Part 2 - 00:51:13
Read by: Denny Sayers

# 12A: Geographical Distribution - Part 1 - 00:47:40
